experimental_method: Vibrating-tube (Hastelloy U-tube, flow, injection-valve) densimeter measuring the density difference between NaCl(aq) and water, 0.0025-5.0 mol/kg, 322-600 K, 0.1-40 MPa; two series (Set I with water and N2 calibration, Set II with water and D2O calibration).
uncertainties_stated: T accurate to 0.05 K at 300 K rising to about 0.2 K at 600 K; pressure gauge 0.3 MPa (set I), 0.1 MPa after calibration (set II); molality better than 0.1 per cent; random error in Delta rho about 0.050 kg/m3 below 450 K and 0.140 kg/m3 above 550 K (set I); set II sigma_r(Delta rho)/(kg/m3) = 0.020 + 0.0011 Delta rho below 400 K, 0.040 + 0.0010 Delta rho above; calibration constant error 0.2 to 0.35 per cent.
quality_remarks: Authors report plateau slopes and adsorption/desorption effects on the tube wall above 400 K for set II (graphical extrapolation of periods used); 600 K set II results not reported; 38 values inconsistent with the rest were excluded from Table 2 by the authors; nine rows at 548.05 K, 24.58-24.72 MPa carry footnote a (excluded from the spline fit, systematic differences). Printed misprints kept as printed (see mapping_2 notes): m = 0.1016 at 597.45 K 20.65 MPa (likely 0.0106), delta_w value 0.05 with two decimals. Temperature scale not stated. Table 2 gives only density differences, not absolute densities.
